title: TCG:Huntik Holotome Tin
summary: The Huntik Holotome Tin is a Huntik Trading Card Game collector's tin containing four randomized booster packs from the Secrets and Seekers, Legendary Saga and Omens and Legacies sets, and one of two exclusive Super Rare TIN- cards. The TIN can be used to store cards inside as well as serving as a collector's display item.

full_text:
The Huntik Holotome Tin is a Huntik Trading Card Game collector's tin containing four randomized booster packs from the Secrets and Seekers, Legendary Saga and Omens and Legacies sets, and one of two exclusive Super Rare TIN- cards. The TIN can be used to store cards inside as well as serving as a collector's display item.

Image caption: Contents of the Holotome tin
